env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2

cd m

# Reserve active and inactive logical overlay sources before selecting
# companion names. Both the inserted declarations and methods must survive.
logos build -overlay=overlay.json -emit-go=out .
exists out/data_jsonv2.go
exists out/data_jsonv2_jsonv2.go
exists out/data_jsonv2_wasip1_wasm.go
exists out/data_jsonv2_jsonv2_wasip1_wasm.go
grep 'OverlayVersion' out/data_jsonv2.go
grep 'WASIVersion' out/data_jsonv2_wasip1_wasm.go
cp stream_check.txt out/stream_check_test.go
cp wasi_check.txt out/wasi_check_test.go

cd out
go run .
stdout '^version 7$'
go test .
go vet .
env GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm
go test -c -o wasi.test .
env GOOS=$TESTGO_GOHOSTOS GOARCH=$TESTGO_GOHOSTARCH

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/overlayjson

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("version", OverlayVersion()) }

-- m/data.lgo --
package main

type Data struct {
	Title string `json:"title"`
}

-- m/data_wasip1_wasm.lgo --
package main

type WASIData struct {
	Title string `json:"title"`
}

-- m/overlay.json --
{
	"Replace": {
		"data_jsonv2.lgo": ".overlay/data_jsonv2.lgo",
		"data_jsonv2_wasip1_wasm.lgo": ".overlay/data_jsonv2_wasip1_wasm.lgo"
	}
}

-- m/.overlay/data_jsonv2.lgo --
package main

func OverlayVersion() int { return 7 }

-- m/.overlay/data_jsonv2_wasip1_wasm.lgo --
package main

func WASIVersion() int { return 9 }

-- m/stream_check.txt --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json/jsontext"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestStreamingMethod(t *testing.T) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	if err := (Data{Title: "hello"}).MarshalJSONTo(jsontext.NewEncoder(&buf)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got := strings.TrimSpace(buf.String()); got != `{"title":"hello"}` {
		t.Fatalf("stream = %q", got)
	}
	if got := OverlayVersion(); got != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("overlay version = %d", got)
	}
}

-- m/wasi_check.txt --
//go:build wasip1 && wasm

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json/jsontext"
	"testing"
)

func TestWASIStreamingMethod(t *testing.T) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	if err := (WASIData{Title: "wasi"}).MarshalJSONTo(jsontext.NewEncoder(&buf)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got := WASIVersion(); got != 9 {
		t.Fatalf("WASI overlay version = %d", got)
	}
}
